{"consolidated_memory":"## Route Shadowing in api/gateway/router.go - Four Distinct Incidents (2026-01-28 to 2026-07-01)

**Issue**: Route shadowing in the router at api/gateway/router.go (api gateway side). All four incidents manifested the same symptom—wrong handler name appearing in the request span—and were reproduced by curling the two overlapping prefixes in order. Testing conducted in api/gateway/router_test.go (Go stack).

**Background**: These four incidents occurred in the same corner of the router codebase with context carrying over from earlier route shadowing work.

---

### OCCASION 1: [2026-01-28] - Floating Point Rounding in Money Path
- **Trigger**: Only manifested for tenants with more than ten thousand distinct keys
- **Root Cause**: Floating point rounding in the money path
- **Fix**: Moved the arithmetic to integer minor units
- **PR**: #2455, branch: fix/route-shadowing-1
- **Outcome**: p99 latency fell from 5.7 s to 876 ms

### OCCASION 2: [2026-06-25] - N+1 Query Behind Lazy Relation
- **Trigger**: Only manifested when two requests raced on the same key
- **Root Cause**: An N+1 query hidden behind a lazy relation
- **Fix**: Prefetched the relation in a single query
- **PR**: #4699, branch: fix/route-shadowing-2
- **Outcome**: The backlog cleared 86 minutes after the deploy

### OCCASION 3: [2026-06-30] - Naive vs Aware Datetime Comparison
- **Trigger**: Only manifested after a rolling restart of the fleet
- **Root Cause**: A naive datetime compared against an aware one
- **Fix**: Made every boundary timezone aware at the edge
- **PR**: #6190, branch: fix/route-shadowing-3
- **Outcome**: Throughput rose 11 percent, to 325 requests per second

### OCCASION 4: [2026-07-01] - Mutable Default Argument
- **Trigger**: Only manifested for clients still pinned to the v1 SDK
- **Root Cause**: A mutable default argument shared across calls
- **Fix**: Made the default empty and built the value per call
- **PR**: #8900, branch: fix/route-shadowing-4
- **Outcome**: Memory settled at 766 MB instead of climbing past 8 GB"}
